daily.title: Get more Instagram views with Trial Reels.
daily.description: Turn ON **Sharing and reuse** in Instagram Settings, then post your reel as a **Trial reel** — it goes to non-followers first. If it performs well, switch the audience to **Everyone** and watch the reach climb.

note.label: Honest note
note.text: Uses real Instagram features — a growth tactic, not a guaranteed hack.

tricks.title: 📈 Get more Instagram views with Trial Reels
tricks.description: A creator trick that uses **real Instagram settings** — no app, no fake website. The idea: let Instagram test your reel on non-followers first, then open it to everyone once it performs.
steps: Open Instagram **Settings → Sharing and reuse**.
Turn ON **Posts and reels to stories**, **Reposts on posts and reels**, and **Allow people to share externally** — more shares = more reach.
Create your reel. When posting, choose **Trial reel** instead of Everyone — Instagram shows it only to non-followers first.
Watch its performance. If it's doing well, switch the reel's audience to **Everyone** to push it wider.

note.label: Honest note
note.text: Trial Reels is a real Instagram feature — this is a growth tactic, not a hack or bot. Better reach is likely, never guaranteed: content quality still decides.

tricks.copy: Instagram views trick: Settings → Sharing and reuse → turn ON share options. Post the reel as a Trial reel (non-followers first). If it performs well, switch audience to Everyone.

tricks.description: Based in Multan, Pakistan, iTechieSIM sells prepaid travel data eSIMs for 195+ countries. The site shows a 7-day plan for Rs 2,215.

note.label: Honest note
note.text: This does not give a non-PTA phone a local Pakistani SIM. It only gives travel data through an eSIM.

steps: Open itechiesim.com, then pick your country and data plan.
Pay. You get a QR code by email and WhatsApp in about 30 seconds.
On iPhone, go to **Settings → Mobile Data → Add eSIM** and scan the QR code. Turn on Data Roaming.
Keep your normal SIM on for WhatsApp and bank OTPs. The eSIM gives you internet.
tricks.title: ✅ iTechieSIM travel eSIM
